Rear dashcam @VERSION@ for Gen5W head units (Android 4.4), as a NEMESIS package: the recorder service and the Dashcam playback app in one install.
@CHANGES@
Install over ADB with `nemesis install --update @ZIP@`, or by USB: extract `@USBZIP@` onto the root of a FAT32/exFAT drive and plug it in. Recording settings carry over when you update. Check downloads against `SHA256SUMS`. `DashcamPlayer.apk` is the app on its own; the package already contains it.

**If the reverse camera ever fails to come up, stop and report it, and uninstall the package until it's fixed.** Details in the README.
